Embedded locked-term matching treats 正道 inside the staff name 永井正道 as the Skill alias 'Chính đạo'. Applying that lock would corrupt a proper name, so this needs a context-rule fix rather than a local translation.

canonical_finding.concept: Exclude staff/creator names from Skill alias matching
canonical_finding.reason: In song-credit text, 正道 occurs only as part of creator name 永井正道, but the embedded context incorrectly matches skill.righteous_path. Staff names must not trigger Skill terminology locks.
